rca_of_the_issue.bug: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'subtotal' before initialization in ReviewOrder component
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: JavaScript const variables have Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ). The useEffect hook added by CR-2026-10-09-003 was placed at line ~156, using `subtotal` in its body (line 161, 168) and dependency array (line 179). However, `subtotal = getTotalPrice()` was declared at line 576 — AFTER the hook. React calls hooks in order during render; when hook at line 156 executes, const `subtotal` is in TDZ and throws ReferenceError, crashing the component.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Moved the useEffect block from line ~156 to after `subtotal` declaration at line 550+. The hook now correctly accesses `subtotal` after it's initialized.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: Navigate to /689/review-order with items in cart → immediate crash with 'Cannot access subtotal before initialization'
